source: The first four reviews were harvested from https://onelightmedical.com/. Eulalia Urias and Terri Smith are published 5-star reviews listed by weightlossclinic.care. Sarah M. and David L. are published patient-success reviews from One Light Medical's official patient site.
note: Christina's quote is the wording in the Figma homepage frame rather than the wording harvested from the live carousel, which read: "Professional, knowledgeable, and very friendly. I would recommend them for weight loss and chiropractic services, although they offer other services as well that I haven't tried yet." The Figma text was used on the clinic's confirmation that it is a genuine quote from the same patient. If that confirmation does not hold, restore the harvested wording above.

items.name: Christina
items.quote: After years of severe joint pain, I wanted an alternative to surgery. The stem cell treatments and care at One Light Medical completely changed my mobility, I'm back to moving without constant pain!

items.name: David Parker
items.quote: I originally was here by the VA for my back in late 2020. I received back injections, an X-ray, and an adjustment. All of my recent treatment has been amazing. Always kind, prompt, and welcoming. I couldn’t recommend Dr. Nelson more.

items.name: Vivian Alvarez
items.quote: First time going and I really seen results, and they were really wonderful, sweet, and made you feel very comfortable. I will be back.

items.name: Keri Bednarz
items.quote: The staff is so kind and took time to explain everything to me. I highly recommend One Light Medical!

items.name: Eulalia Urias
items.quote: I just finished my sessions for my shoulder and it was a short process, the first time was so simple and helped my shoulder to relax and free of pain I recovery from my pain so fast I didn't miss work 🙃 than you ONE LIGH MEDICAL. YOU WERE OWSEM

items.name: Terri Smith
items.quote: I got stem cell injections in both knees and Dr. Nelson and his staff are absolutely amazing. I feel great and I’m able to walk without pain.

items.name: Sarah M.
items.quote: I was nervous about seeking treatment for my arthritis, but they made me feel comfortable and at ease. The treatments have been effective, and I've noticed a significant improvement in my mobility.

items.name: David L.
items.quote: The doctors are knowledgeable and experienced, and they use the latest techniques to manage pain. I've been able to avoid surgery thanks to their care, and I'm so happy with the results.
